rules: bare C-number labels are local trace metadata only
routing, collision detection and successor selection must use trail_id plus cycle_uid
cycle_uid must remain immutable after materialization
legacy numeric labels are preserved append-only and never rewritten as if they were globally unique
superseded concurrent trails are closed without merge and remain recoverable by PR/commit
a derived view never becomes authority merely by having a later numeric cycle label
claim_allowed remains false unless the underlying epistemic gate independently allows promotion
F_next: materialize a repository-wide identity registry/linter that enumerates active cycle-bearing artifacts and rejects duplicate cycle_uid while preserving legacy local labels
